HOW TO GET INTERNET (SYSTEMWIDE, TCP+UDP)

1. Start proxy, then connect your PC/device to the Access Point SSID shown above.
2. On the PC, install Clash Verge Rev (free, open source).
 It captures ALL traffic systemwide via TUN mode: TCP, UDP and ICMP.
3. In Clash Verge Rev add a proxy:
 type: SOCKS5, server: (phone AP IP, usually 192.168.49.1),
 port: (port above), udp: true.
4. Enable TUN Mode (Settings -> TUN Mode) - requires admin once.
 TUN captures everything: browsers, games, DNS, UDP apps.
Alternatives: Netch or v2rayN (TUN mode) - all support systemwide UDP.

VIVO Y16 KEEP-ALIVE:
- Settings > More settings > Applications > Autostart > enable Sacram
- Settings > Battery > High background power consumption > enable Sacram
- Lock the app in the recent-apps list (padlock icon)
- Battery > Battery optimization > set to "Not optimized"
- Settings > Battery > Sleep Standby > exclude Sacram
